title: Not Very Well
hook: 佩奇脸上长满红点，只好躺在床上，还让来看她的小伙伴去要冰淇淋。

cells.q: What did Mummy and Daddy Pig make for the children?
cells.a: They made breakfast for Peppa and George.
cells.cn: 他们给佩奇和乔治做好了早餐。

cells.q: What is wrong with Peppa's face?
cells.a: Her face is covered in little red spots.

cells.q: What did Dr. Brown Bear offer Peppa?
cells.a: He said he could give her just a little medicine.
cells.cn: 他说可以给她吃一点点药。

cells.q: Can Peppa's friends come to see her?
cells.a: Yes, the doctor says she can have visitors.
cells.cn: 可以，医生说可以让朋友来看她。

cells.q: What did Peppa tell her friends?
cells.a: She said, “I'm not very well. I have red spots.”
cells.cn: 她说：“我不太舒服，我脸上有红点。”

cells.q: Where does Peppa have to stay?
cells.a: She has to stay in bed, so her friends come to her.
cells.cn: 她必须待在床上，所以朋友们来看她。

cells.q: What did Peppa keep telling Suzy Sheep?
cells.a: She kept saying that she has to stay in bed.
cells.cn: 她一直说自己必须待在床上。

cells.q: What did Peppa want her friends to ask for?
cells.a: She wanted them to ask her mummy for some ice cream.
cells.cn: 她想让朋友去跟她妈妈要冰淇淋。

cells.q: What did the doctor say at the end?
cells.a: He said, “No more red spots! You're completely better!”
cells.cn: 他说：“红点没了！你全好了！”

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: spots, doctor, medicine, visitor, ice cream, better
helper.actions: make, check, take, stay, visit, feel

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Not Very Well”.
ending: In the end, Peppa is completely better. My favourite part is ______.
